projectContext: Sprints 13-14 (testing) completed 20 stories covering rate-limiting intelligence tests and integration-level download/escalation/cookie/budget tests. Sprint 15 pivots to under-tested non-download modules: post-edit analysis (1666 lines, 1 indirect test), CLI config_utils (368 lines, no direct tests), newproject.py (331 lines, zero tests), checkpoint corruption recovery (784 lines, basic tests only), pipeline orchestrator resume logic (521 lines, basic tests), vision module cost tracking (544 lines, basic tests), and state dataclass serialization edge cases. These modules handle critical user-facing and pipeline-integrity functionality with minimal test coverage.

userStories.title: Add post-edit analysis filename-based matching tests
userStories.notes: Created tests/test_post_edit_analysis.py with 55 tests: 12 for _is_matcher_track (V1-V10, V11/V100 false, keywords), 17 for _get_track_category (all categories + keywords + None), 7 for _render_coverage_bar (0/50/100%, custom width), 9 for _format_timecode (MM:SS, HH:MM:SS, negative, zero), 10 for filename-based analysis (_normalize, FilenameAnalysisResult counts/coverage/to_dict).
acceptanceCriteria: Test _is_matcher_track() correctly identifies V1-V10 track names — verify True for 'V1', 'V10', 'V1 Primary', and False for 'V11', 'V100', 'Audio 1'
Test _get_track_category() returns correct categories — verify 'v1' for V1, 'v2_v3' for V2/V3, 'v4_v6' for V4-V6, 'v7_plus' for V7+, None for non-matcher tracks
Test _render_coverage_bar() renders ASCII bars — verify 100% yields '[##########]', 0% yields '[..........]', 50% yields '[#####.....]'
Test _format_timecode() formats seconds — verify 90s='1:30', 3661s='1:01:01', negative seconds prepends '-', 0s='0:00'
Test filename-based analysis matches clips by normalized filename across original and edited OTIO — verify clips found, clips missing, and coverage percentage calculation

userStories.title: Add checkpoint corruption recovery tests
userStories.notes: Created tests/test_checkpoint_corruption_recovery.py with 27 tests across 5 classes: TestBackupFallbackOnCorruption (4 tests: corrupted/empty/truncated primary restored from backup, primary file restored after fallback), TestBothCorrupted (5 tests: both corrupted/empty/too-small/arrays returns None, no backup returns None), TestSaveCreatesBackup (4 tests: backup contains pre-save state, backup updates on each save, no backup on first save, save_intermediate creates backup), TestIsStaleThresholds (8 tests: 25h stale, 23h fresh, 24h+1m boundary, 23h59m boundary, custom 1h threshold, created_at fallback, no timestamp), TestNonSerializableStageData (6 tests: datetime/Path/set/bytes/mixed types all handled via default=str, serializable data preserved alongside).
acceptanceCriteria: Test load() falls back to backup when primary checkpoint.json is corrupted JSON — verify data loaded from checkpoint.backup.json matches saved state
Test load() returns None when both checkpoint.json and backup are corrupted — verify no exception raised, returns None gracefully
Test save() creates backup of previous checkpoint before overwriting — verify checkpoint.backup.json contains the pre-save state after save() call
Test is_stale() correctly identifies checkpoints older than max_age_hours — verify True for 25-hour-old checkpoint with default 24h threshold, False for 23-hour-old
Test save() with stage data containing non-serializable objects — verify graceful handling (skip or convert) rather than json.dumps crash

userStories.title: Add pipeline orchestrator resume logic tests
userStories.notes: Added TestResumeLogic class with 11 tests to tests/test_pipeline_orchestrator.py: resume skips stages before checkpoint (3-stage and 2-of-3 variants), fresh run executes all stages in order with callback verification, fresh run doesn't call can_skip, halts on failure (subsequent not called + returns False), timing recorded per completed stage, timing absent for stages after failure, callbacks fire with correct stage names, callbacks interleave start/complete correctly, callbacks receive success result. Test stage callbacks fire correctly — register on_stage_start and on_stage_complete callbacks, verify both called with correct stage name for each stage
